title: Jim Jordan Eviscerates Denver Mayor Over Sanctuary Policies, Gang Member's Release [WATCH]
text:
House Judiciary Committee Chairman Jim Jordan (R-OH) left Denver Mayor Mike Johnston scrambling for answers after a blistering takedown over his city’s dangerous sanctuary policies.
As The Gateway Pudit reported, in a heated exchange during Wednesday’s House Oversight Committee hearing, Jordan exposed how Denver’s reckless approach to illegal immigration directly endangered law enforcement officers and the public.
Johnston, alongside other pro-illegal immigration mayors—including Boston’s Michelle Wu, Chicago’s Brandon Johnson, and New York’s Eric Adams—testified before Congress, attempting to defend their disastrous policies.
Elon Musk Called This Financial News 'Terrifying'
But Jordan wasn’t buying their excuses, especially when it came to the case of Abraham Gonzales, a Venezuelan gang member who should have never been allowed to roam free in the U.S.
Gonzales was apprehended by Border Patrol in September 2023 but, thanks to Biden’s border disaster, was released into the country. He wasted no time accumulating charges in Denver, including aggravated assault, motor vehicle theft, and felony menacing.
Despite being behind bars for nearly a year, Denver authorities refused to cooperate fully with ICE.
On March 26, 2024, Jordan’s team sent Denver officials a detainer request—a simple 48-hour heads-up before Gonzales was released. What did Johnston’s sanctuary city do instead?
They gave ICE a measly one-hour notice and dumped Gonzales into a parking lot, forcing ICE agents to scramble. The result? A violent confrontation that ended with an ICE officer assaulted and agents forced to deploy tasers to subdue the criminal.
Jordan held nothing back, pressing Johnston on why his city refused to comply with a straightforward federal request.
“You had him in custody for 345 days. I said, ‘Hey, can you give us 48 hours?’ You gave them one hour. One hour!”
Johnston weakly claimed that Denver had “notified” ICE, but Jordan wasn’t buying it. The fact remained: instead of handing Gonzales over in a controlled environment, Denver officials chose to unleash him onto the streets, forcing ICE to handle the situation in a chaotic public setting.
“If you’d held him inside, it’d take two officers, not six. But you won’t do it that way—because you’re a sanctuary city.”
Johnston desperately tried to defend his policies, insisting that Denver doesn’t “shield” criminals from law enforcement. He even boasted that 1,226 releases had gone smoothly—ignoring the fact that it only takes one violent criminal to prove his policies are a disaster.
Jordan wasn’t having any of it.
“I’m asking about one—Mr. Abraham Gonzales, gang member, car thief, assaulter. An officer got assaulted because of your policy!”
In typical liberal fashion, Johnston offered nothing but bureaucratic nonsense, suggesting he would “sit down with ICE” to adjust procedures—after the damage was already done.
Jordan then dropped the hammer: sanctuary policies don’t make cities safer. They make them more dangerous, especially for law enforcement officers forced to clean up the mess left by Democrat leaders.
“I read your written testimony last night—four and a half pages. You used the words ‘safe,’ ‘safer,’ or ‘safety’ 13 times. That’s a lie.”
Jordan pointed out the blatant hypocrisy of Johnston’s claims, highlighting how his sanctuary policies did nothing to protect the ICE agents who were violently attacked.
Instead of ensuring safety, Denver’s policies created a needless, high-risk situation that could have been avoided.
“The safest thing to do is to say, “ICE, we got him in custody. Come here, we’re releasing him.” We held him 345 days. We can’t hold him a second longer? We can’t wait for you to come inside the building? We have to let him go, so you have to arrest him in the parking lot?”
Jim Jordan just ripped the Mayor of Denver APART for five minutes straight.
“Who’s Abraham Gonzalez?”
Mayor Johnston: “He is an individual that was released from the county jail on Friday in the City and County of Denver.”
Jordan: …Venezuelan gang member arrested by Border…
[pic.twitter.com/fMX6jEHECF]— George (@BehizyTweets)
[March 5, 2025]
This is the undeniable reality of sanctuary city policies: they don’t protect American citizens or law enforcement. They prioritize the comfort of criminal illegal aliens over the safety of the communities these Democrat-run cities claim to serve.
Once again, Jordan exposed the left’s open-border insanity for what it is—a dangerous, lawless agenda that puts Americans last.
